subject.title: fix(ai): record token usage on Responses early-abort (#100954)

question: Must this PR demonstrate the linked issue’s client-cancellation or first-byte-timeout path on a live Azure/OpenAI deployment before it can close that issue?
rationale: The code and synthetic processor tests establish correct handling when a populated `response.incomplete` event arrives, but they do not establish that the original abort scenario produces that event before local cancellation stops consumption.

options.title: Require live abort proof

options.title: Approve a scoped proof override
